role_summary: Lead the Hong Kong technology team to ensure smooth operations, alignment with global standards, and delivery of strategic initiatives. Act as the bridge between business stakeholders and global technology, driving digital transformation, regulatory compliance, and adoption of emerging technologies like AI and DLT. Manage a diverse team and foster agile delivery and problem-solving skills.
must_have_requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline
10+ years of relevant experience in technology leadership roles
Proven experience leading technology functions within a global financial services organization
Strong track record of delivering large-scale technology, digital transformation, and change management initiatives
Understanding of investment management business processes
Knowledge of technology delivery best practices (e.g., agile, DevOps)
Experience engaging with regulatory bodies and handling client due diligence (DDQs, RFPs)
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
Ability to build and lead high-performing teams with diverse skill sets
nice_to_have_requirements: Awareness of emerging technology trends in AI, DLT, and Quantum Computing
Experience with AI or blockchain implementation in financial services
Advanced degree (MBA, Master's) in a relevant field
Experience in both business and technology roles
Familiarity with Hong Kong regulatory landscape (e.g., SFC, HKMA)

scoring_criteria.name: Leadership Experience
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: The role requires leading a local technology team and ensuring successful technology functions, so proven leadership is essential.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Title with 'Head', 'Director', 'Senior Manager' in tech
Number of years managing teams
Examples of team building, mentoring, and managing diverse skills
Budget or resource management experience
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates may have only team lead experience, not functional leadership

scoring_criteria.name: Global Financial Services Experience
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: The JD explicitly requires experience leading technology within global financial services, indicating deep domain knowledge and ability to navigate complex global structures.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Employment at well-known financial institutions
Project exposure to investment management or banking
Understanding of global regulatory environments
Experience with global teams and cross-border initiatives
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates from non-financial industries may lack domain nuance

scoring_criteria.name: Digital Transformation & Change Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Strong track record of delivering large-scale transformation is required, showing ability to drive modernization and handle organizational change.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Initiatives like cloud adoption, agile transformation, IT modernization
Quantified outcomes (e.g., cost savings, improved delivery speed)
Change management certifications or methodologies (e.g., Prosci)
Stories of overcoming resistance and achieving adoption
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Some may have transformation experience but smaller scale

scoring_criteria.name: Stakeholder Management & Communication
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: The role is the bridge between business stakeholders, regional leadership, and global functions, so advanced communication and relationship skills are critical.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Experience presenting to C-level or executive committees
Strong written communication (reports, proposals)
Examples of building trusted relationships with non-technical leaders
Handling difficult conversations and expectations
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates may have technical depth but limited executive presence

scoring_criteria.name: Investment Management Business Processes
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Understanding of investment management processes ensures alignment of technology solutions with business needs and adds credibility with stakeholders.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Experience working in or with front, middle, or back office in asset management
Knowledge of trading, portfolio management, compliance, or risk systems
Participation in projects supporting investment operations
Relevant certifications (e.g., CFA, FRM)
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates from other financial sectors may lack specific investment knowledge

scoring_criteria.name: Technology Delivery Best Practices
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: The JD mentions knowledge of technology delivery best practices, indicating need for agile, DevOps, and modern delivery methodologies.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Experience with agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban)
DevOps practices including CI/CD, automation
Project management methodologies (PMI, PRINCE2)
Use of tools like Jira, Azure DevOps, etc.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Some may have traditional waterfall experience only

scoring_criteria.name: Regulatory & Compliance Engagement
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: The role involves local regulatory engagements and client requests (DDQs, RFPs), so familiarity with compliance is necessary.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Experiences with regulators like SFC, HKMA, SEC, or FCA
Handling audits, exams, or regulatory submissions
Coordinating responses to DDQs or RFPs
Knowledge of cybersecurity standards (ISO, NIST) and business continuity
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: May not have direct regulatory interaction but can be developed

scoring_criteria.name: Emerging Technology Awareness
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: JD mentions awareness of AI, DLT, and Quantum Computing as part of advocating best-in-class solutions, so some knowledge is expected.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Certifications or courses in AI/ML, blockchain, or quantum
Projects involving AI, automation, or blockchain
Thought leadership articles or talks
Active participation in tech communities
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Awareness is enough, not deep expertise

scoring_criteria.name: Talent Management & Team Development
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: The JD emphasizes managing talent with diverse skillsets and cultivating agile, problem-solving, and communication skills among team members.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Experience hiring and building teams
Mentoring and coaching examples
Performance management and career development initiatives
Creating a positive team culture
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: May have led teams but not actively developed people

scoring_criteria.name: Education & Formal Qualifications
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: A bachelor's degree in a relevant field is required, and advanced degrees are a plus.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Degree in CS, IT, Engineering, or related
Advanced degree (MBA, MS)
Relevant certifications (e.g., ITIL, PMP, AWS, Azure)
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Rarely missing but could be non-STEM degree

summary_focus: Proven track record in digital transformation and change management
Expert in stakeholder engagement and regulatory compliance
Passionate about emerging technologies (AI, DLT) to drive business value
Experienced in leading diverse teams and fostering agile delivery
do_not_overclaim: Do not claim deep expertise in quantum computing if you only have awareness
Do not overstate leadership scope if you only led a small team
Do not claim direct regulatory experience if you only supported others
Avoid claiming investment management process expertise without concrete examples

cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Position yourself as a strategic technology leader who bridges business and technology, with a strong history of delivering transformation in global financial services and a pulse on emerging tech trends.
bridge_gaps_honestly: If lacking direct investment management experience, highlight adjacent financial services and willingness to learn quickly
If no explicit AI/DLT project, showcase continuous learning and awareness through courses or research
If leadership experience is at a smaller scale, emphasize the depth and impact of your management
If regulatory experience is limited, mention experience with audits or compliance alignment in previous roles
